name: Hottererhof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Hottererhof in Gerlos** – your cozy retreat in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**!

Nestled at **1,200 meters** above sea level, this charming **family-run guesthouse** offers breathtaking views of the **Gerlostal Valley** and the majestic **Hochfeiler** mountain range. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, the **Hottererhof** is your perfect base for exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**.

Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** cuisine, including our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** and homemade **Apfelstrudel**, while enjoying the warmth of our rustic **Stube**. After a day of hiking, skiing, or simply soaking in the alpine air, unwind in our cozy common room with a glass of local **Tiroler** wine or a steaming **Kaffee**.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, the **Hottererhof** is easily accessible yet feels worlds away from the hustle and bustle. Experience authentic **Tiroler** hospitality in a setting where tradition meets modern comfort.

**Come and discover why the Hottererhof is a beloved hideaway for travelers from around the world!**
